slides.title: Welcome to the Truckstop Partner Community
slides.subtitle: Driving Mutual Success in Freight Logistics
bullets: Embark on a collaborative journey for mutual success
Foster innovation and growth in the transportation industry
Maximize your partnership potential with Truckstop
slides.body: We believe in the power of partnerships and the strength of community. Together, we can achieve more.
slides.visual_direction: Hero image of diverse business professionals collaborating, with the Truckstop logo prominently displayed.
slides.speaker_notes: Welcome our partners and set the stage for the value of joining the Truckstop Partner Community.

slides.title: Truckstop: Nearly 30 Years of Innovation
slides.subtitle: Empowering the Freight Community Since 1995
bullets: Founded in 1995 as the Internet's first load board
Delivering innovative solutions across the freight lifecycle
Supporting carriers, brokers, and shippers with essential technology
slides.body: Our mission is to empower the freight community with trusted and innovative solutions, creating a 'Better Way' for everyone to grow and prosper.
slides.visual_direction: Timeline graphic highlighting key milestones from 1995 to present, with a focus on innovation in freight technology.
slides.speaker_notes: Provide a brief history of Truckstop, emphasizing our legacy and ongoing commitment to the industry.

slides.title: The Truckstop Partner Community: An Ecosystem of Value
slides.subtitle: Extend Your Reach to a Vast Audience
bullets: An extension of our internal teams, fostering collaboration
Drives value and delivers exceptional results for all stakeholders
Connects your business to carriers, brokers, and shippers
slides.body: Join our vibrant ecosystem where ideas flourish, and innovation fuels the transportation industry. Your offerings will be listed in the industry's most comprehensive freight marketplace.
slides.visual_direction: Infographic showing interconnected circles representing partners, Truckstop, carriers, brokers, and shippers, highlighting a seamless ecosystem.
slides.speaker_notes: Explain the core purpose and benefits of the Partner Community, emphasizing market reach.

slides.title: Partnership Models: Referral & Integrations
slides.subtitle: Choose the Path That Best Fits Your Business
bullets: **Integrations Partners:** Deep technical integration, marketplace listing
Gain access to our PartnerStack portal for resources and tracking
slides.body: Not sure which model is right for you? You can be both! Our team can help you explore the best fit for your business goals.
slides.visual_direction: Two-column layout. Left: 'Referral Partnership' with icons for introduction and reward. Right: 'Integrations Partnership' with icons for API and marketplace listing. A 'Best of Both Worlds' callout.
slides.speaker_notes: Detail the two main types of partnerships, their requirements, and key benefits, including the PartnerStack platform.
